verdict.rationale: GitHub confirms an official Copilot CLI (probe-4) and terminal integration via GitHub CLI and Windows Terminal Canary (docs-5), plus local sandbox execution for agent mode (docs-16), showing a real local terminal agent path. However, the terminal chat integration is explicitly called out as still in 'Canary' (experimental) status and there's no independent/community evidence validating the CLI agent experience in practice. Missing for 10: hands-on community verification of the terminal/CLI agent workflow, and confirmation the CLI is fully GA rather than experimental in all channels.
